question: Who is the author of ‘Half Girlfriend and One Indian Girl’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chetan Bhagat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• Chetan Bhagat is a renowned Indian author known for his English-language novels that appeal to the masses.

• He has written several bestsellers, including 'Five Point Someone', '2 States', and 'One Night @ the Call Center'.

• 'Half Girlfriend' and 'One Indian Girl' are two of his popular novels, both of which have been adapted into films.

• His writing often addresses contemporary issues faced by Indian youth, making his books relatable and widely read.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **'Half Girlfriend'**

• This novel was published in 2014 and revolves around the story of a rural boy from Bihar who enrolls at a prestigious English-medium college in Delhi.

• The plot explores issues of language barriers and the complexities of modern-day relationships.

• The book was adapted into a Bollywood film of the same name in 2017, starring Arjun Kapoor and Shraddha Kapoor.

• **'One Indian Girl'**

• Published in 2016, this novel is written from the perspective of a female protagonist, Radhika Mehta, a successful investment banker.

• The book deals with themes of feminism, career vs. personal life, and the societal expectations from women in India.

• It provides a deep dive into the struggles of modern Indian women in balancing their professional and personal lives.

• **Chetan Bhagat's Impact**

• Chetan Bhagat has been credited with popularizing the English language novel among the Indian youth.

• His books often delve into the aspirations and challenges of urban middle-class youth, making them highly relatable.

• Several of his novels have been adapted into successful Bollywood movies, further extending his influence and reach.

• He has also written columns and articles on various socio-economic issues, contributing to public discourse in India.
